verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a first-party Lago Agent SDK that wraps an existing LLM client (lago-docs-24), and an OpenAPI 3.1 schema, confirmed reachable by probe, for generating typed clients (lago-docs-16, lago-probe-3). However, the pack never documents official general-purpose language SDKs for the billing API, so building against Lago may mean generating your own clients. Missing for 10: documented official language SDKs (e.g. Python/Node/Ruby) for the core API, SDK reference docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
